ideas.summaryFa: یکی وسایل تمرین جمع می‌کند؛ دیگری تمرین می‌کند. وقتِ بالا بردن ساک، نتیجه در توانایی خودشان دیده می‌شود.
ideas.storyFa: در ستون راست، آدمک زرد وسایل ورزشی نو جمع می‌کند و بعد برای بالا بردن ساک خرید از یک پلهٔ کوتاه به زحمت می‌افتد. در ستون چپ، آدمک سبز با یک وزنه تمرین می‌کند و بعد همان ساک با همان بار را راحت از همان پله بالا می‌برد.
ideas.meaningFa: تمرین، توانایی خودِ فرد را رشد می‌دهد؛ داشتن وسایل به‌تنهایی جای این رشد را نمی‌گیرد. تفاوت در حالت و انجام یک کار یکسان دیده می‌شود، نه در بدن یا بار ساک.

ideas.summaryFa: راهنمای تازه‌کار نخست با کمک از پل می‌گذرد؛ چند ماه بعد خودش همراهی مردد را راهنمایی می‌کند.
ideas.storyFa: در قاب بالا، آدمک صورتیِ تازه‌کار با کولهٔ قهوه‌ای از قدم‌گذاشتن روی پل کوتاه مردد است و راهنمای فیروزه‌ای دستش را می‌گیرد. در قاب پایین، همان آدمک صورتی روی همان پل با آرامش دست همراه بنفش را گرفته و او را جلو می‌برد؛ همراه زرد هم پشت سر آنهاست. تابلوی «تور طبیعت» موقعیت کاری را نشان می‌دهد.
ideas.meaningFa: تجربهٔ کار، اعتمادبه‌نفس و توانایی راهنمای تازه‌کار را رشد داده است؛ اکنون می‌تواند حمایتی را که قبلاً گرفته بود به دیگری بدهد.

ideas.titleFa: حقوق و چیزی که یاد گرفتم
ideas.summaryFa: کارگر با یادگرفتن استفاده از دو غلطک موجود، جعبه را راحت‌تر حرکت می‌دهد و به همکار تازه کمک می‌کند.
ideas.storyFa: بالا سمت راست، آدمک بنفش برای هل‌دادن جعبه زحمت می‌کشد و دو غلطک کنار آن بلااستفاده‌اند. بالا سمت چپ، همکار فیروزه‌ای جعبه را روی همان دو غلطک حرکت می‌دهد و بنفش نگاه می‌کند. پایین، بنفش همین روش را برای جعبهٔ همکار صورتی به‌کار می‌برد و می‌گوید «حالا بلدم!». پاکت کوچک «حقوق» روی میز کنار صحنه است.
ideas.meaningFa: در کنار درآمد، کار توانایی فرد را با یادگیری یک روش مفید رشد می‌دهد؛ او بعداً با آنچه آموخته به دیگری کمک می‌کند.
ideas.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE new square 1:1 watercolor book illustration at normal original quality. Three scenes: upper RIGHT first, upper LEFT second, one wide lower scene last; white separation without heavy borders.

The attached approved illustration is a STYLE reference only: watercolor, circular heads, modest dark oval eyes, local-color contours, balanced medium adult proportions and white margins. NEVER copy its apron, tailor, sewing machine, room or props. ALL three characters have PLAIN single-color bodies, NO APRONS OR CLOTHES.

Story: work teaches an existing useful method, which the worker then shares. Simple restrained warehouse; plain unmarked cardboard boxes, sparse shelf and floor, no English.
UPPER RIGHT: purple novice struggles to push a large box along the floor, leaning with effort and a mildly comic frustrated face. TWO short brown wooden cylindrical rollers already lie visibly beside that box, unused.
UPPER LEFT: turquoise colleague demonstrates by placing THOSE SAME TWO rollers under the SAME box, one front and one back, and moving it easily. Purple watches attentively. Show recognizable cylinders and their support of the box, not wheels or new equipment.
LOWER: SAME purple now confidently places the SAME TWO wooden rollers under another box belonging to a new pink adult colleague, helping that box move easily. Pink stands beside it, impressed and relieved. Purple speech bubble exactly «حالا بلدم!». A small peripheral pay envelope on a side table reads exactly «حقوق». Learning and helping are the visual focus; the envelope is secondary. No extra tools, rollers, rewards or trophies.

All characters keep fixed body colors and identity. Pink has only a few fine short upper-outer lashes on the SAME dark oval eyes; no large doll eyes or white sclera. Tiny interior eye glints allowed. Every head is a PERFECT CIRCLE, no jaw, chin or neck; directly joins shoulders with soft local-color contact shadow. No noses, ears or hair. Same neutral medium adult body build: gently almost-parallel torso sides, NO breasts, pinched waist, wide hips or buttocks, neither stretched/thin nor chunky/chibi. Visible hands exactly THREE fingers plus ONE thumb; natural grip occlusion allowed.

Authentic moderate watercolor: broad overlapping irregular translucent washes INSIDE all heads, torsos, limbs and hands plus setting, subtle pooling and luminous paper. Darker-local-body-color outlines, never black body outlines. No flat/vector fill, uniform fine marker grain, glossy 3D or heavy mottling.

Fully include feet, bodies, boxes and cylinders within clean white paper margins. Sparse purposeful setting, natural irregular painted endings; pigment never reaches file edges. Correct connected RTL Persian; only the TWO specified texts. Warm gentle family-friendly humor.

ideas.storyFa: در قاب بالا، مشتری خاکستری فنجان را روی میز ریخته؛ کارمند مرجانی اخم می‌کند و همکار فیروزه‌ای با آرامش دستمال می‌آورد. در قاب پایین همان مشتری و فنجانِ ریخته دیده می‌شوند، اما مرجانی با لبخند دستمال و فنجان تازه می‌دهد و می‌گوید «عیبی نداره!». هر دو کارمند پیش‌بند کرم یکسان دارند و پاکت کوچک «حقوق» در هر دو قاب روی قفسه است.

ideas.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / illustration-story. Image 1 is the actual edit target, the three-scene purple/green boat illustration. Image 2 is STYLE AND CHARACTER PAINT reference ONLY, not a story to copy.
Revise Image 1 while preserving its square layout, cast identities (purple main adult, green other adult), tan wooden boats, green identifying bow stripe on purple's boat, thought texts, local lake setting, story and complete boat/oar framing.
Primary correction requested by owner: remove every sharply bounded round hot-pink cheek spot from BOTH characters in ALL scenes. Replace with at most a whisper of transparent diffuse watercolor integrated into the underlying body paint, as in Image 2; never a sticker-like cheek disc. Keep small eyes, facial expressions and neutral bodies.
Narrative must remain: upper RIGHT purple looks directly AT green struggling to row, with Persian thought «این چه پارو زدنیه؟!»; purple's own boat visibly has a small puddle and leak. Upper LEFT purple pauses worried and genuinely looks at the leak of their OWN boat, accepts the problem and presses the small square wooden repair patch against that same hull, thought «قایق خودم سوراخه!». Lower scene the same purple boat is now dry/repaired, the square patch visible, purple rows with relaxed warm smile. Make personal improvement the emphasis; other rower need not remain visibly incompetent or be mocked in the last scene. Repair is a tangible consequence of turning attention inward.
Keep ALL boats and ALL oars completely inside scene boundaries, with painted-edge breathing space, not cut off. Do not add English, new clothes or extra characters.
Style invariants: closely match the hand-painted book style of reference Image 2. Moderate real layered watercolor INSIDE heads, torsos, limbs and hands, broad overlapping translucent washes, paper texture and subtle pigment pooling. Clear outlines are darker shades of each body's OWN color, never black outlines. NOT vector, marker, colored-pencil grain, glossy 3D or heavily embossed/mottled texture. All heads must be PERFECT CIRCLES with equal width and height, no oval, chin, jaw, ears, hair, nose or neck. Head directly joins shoulders, with a soft local-colored crescent contact shadow below it. Balanced medium adult simple neutral bodies, not chubby, not skinny; same neutral silhouette for all genders, no bust, pinched waist, protruding hip or buttock, waist notch or feminine curve. Match the reference's small dark oval eyes with one tiny glint INSIDE allowed, NEVER white sclera. Pink character may have only 2-3 short fine upper-outer eyelashes, same eye shape and size. Hands have exactly three fingers and one thumb when visible; natural grips/occlusion allowed. No separate bright pink blush spots: either no blush or extremely subtle transparent diffuse wash blended into body color. Plain colored bodies for everyone, no special clothes. All feet, bodies, important props fully inside each scene, white breathing margins all around. All text ONLY short correct connected Persian, no English, no numbers or watermark. Family-friendly, warm but emotionally clear, tasteful adult book illustration. Square 1:1 canvas; three scenes with thin white gaps, two upper scenes read RIGHT THEN LEFT, one large lower scene as payoff; soft naturally painted scene edges, no heavy borders.

ideas.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE NEW book illustration, SQUARE 1:1, two vertically stacked scenes with a slim white paper gap. The input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its authentic moderate translucent layered watercolor painting, balanced neutral adult figures, modest expressive dark oval eyes with tiny white glints inside, colored outlines and white irregular paper edges. Do NOT copy its tailor, apron, sewing room, objects, writing, or portrait canvas.

Story: «اخمِ خودم». A person easily notices someone else's grumpy face, then notices the SAME flaw in themself and repairs their own attitude. The correction visibly improves the relationship. Simple warm human wit, readable for a twelve-year-old without outside explanation.

Scene TOP: In a quiet bright indoor entryway, TWO plain adult figures, one RED and one BLUE, face each other. BLUE has a mild frown, otherwise calm. RED has an even more obvious frown, with an accusing pointing hand aimed at BLUE. A small thought bubble clearly belonging to RED reads exactly «چرا اینقدر اخموئه؟». Beside RED, a simple tall freestanding mirror, tilted naturally towards RED, shows ONLY the real reflection of RED: the same red circular head, SAME exaggerated frown, SAME accusatory pointing gesture, correctly mirrored. RED's gaze has just turned toward this reflection, registering surprise at their own expression. Position RED close to the mirror at an oblique three-quarter angle and BLUE a little farther right, so it is physically clear that the mirror is reflecting RED and NOT a third person. Use a simple flat mirror, not a magical duplicate; feet and mirror stand fully included.

Scene BOTTOM: SAME indoor entryway, SAME RED and BLUE figures, SAME mirror in SAME position. RED is now smiling softly, the pointing finger lowered, offering a friendly open hand. BLUE smiles and takes RED's hand in a warm handshake/reconciliation. The mirror accurately reflects RED's changed friendly face and body posture, with the free hand lowered and no pointing. A small bubble clearly belongs to RED and reads exactly «منم اخم کرده بودم.» The social result is obvious from the two warm expressions and friendly hands. Nothing else written. No moral caption.

STRICT character design: perfectly round circular heads, not oval, no jaw or chin or ears or nose or hair. Heads meet shoulders directly with NO neck. A soft darker local-color contact crescent directly under the head separates it from the upper torso. Medium balanced adult neutral bodies; SAME simple body build for both. No female body curves, no narrow waist, no bulging chest or hips, no chubby arms or bellies, no elongated thin limbs, no chibi. No special clothes on either figure. Both have the same small dark oval eyes, tiny white internal catchlight allowed but absolutely NO white sclera or white eye area around pupils. Every visible hand must have precisely three fingers plus one thumb; natural handshake occlusion is fine. RED remains red in BOTH scenes, BLUE remains blue in BOTH scenes. Body and head outlines are darker shades of their OWN body colors, NEVER black contours. Eyes and text may be dark.
Watercolor must be apparent INSIDE heads, torsos, arms, hands and feet: broad softly uneven overlapping transparent washes with some luminous paper showing, varied pigment density and subtle pools, restrained strength. Clear warm colored contours, NOT uniform colored-pencil or marker grain, NOT flat vector, NOT glossy 3D, NOT heavy mottling.
Composition: full bodies, ALL feet, mirror stand and meaningful props inside each scene with ample white exterior margin; pull the camera out far enough, no feet cropped at bottom. Sparse setting, no distracting decorations. Two scene sequence top to bottom, coherent geometry and exact same identities. All lettering Persian only, correct connected letters RTL. Only the two exact short Persian lines specified above. No English, no watermarks.
ideas.title: اخمِ خودم

ideas.summaryFa: آدمک زرد از کندی دیگری ایراد می‌گیرد، اما مشکل اصلی بند دو کفش خودش است که به هم گره خورده‌اند.
ideas.storyFa: بالا، زرد دیگری را قضاوت می‌کند و تازه متوجه می‌شود بند کفش‌های خودش به هم بسته شده و نمی‌تواند آزاد قدم بردارد. پایین، بند هر کفش را جدا و درست بسته و حالا راحت به سوی خط پایان می‌دود.
